question: Where was the first All-India Kisan Sabha formed?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lucknow.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The first All-India Kisan Sabha was formed in Lucknow in 1936.**
 
• **It was formed under the leadership of N.G. Ranga and Swami Sahajanand Saraswati.**
 
• The main objective of the Sabha was to unite farmers and agricultural workers against the oppressive policies of the British government.
 
• The Sabha played an important role in the Indian independence movement and continued to work for the welfare of farmers even after India gained independence.
 
• The All India Kisan Sabha is now known as the **All India Kisan Sabha** **(AIKS)** and is one of the largest organizations representing farmers in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lahore **was the venue for the** 1940 session** of the All India Muslim League, where the historic Pakistan Resolution was passed.
 
• **Amritsar** is famous for the **Jallianwala Bagh massacre.**
 
 
• **It took place on 13 April 1919, when British Indian Army soldiers under the command of Colonel Reginald Dyer fired rifles into a crowd of unarmed Indian civilians who were protesting peacefully against the British rule.**
 
 
 
• **Delh**i is the capital city of India and has played a significant role in the country's history and politics.
 
 
• **It was the site of many important events during the Indian independence movement, including the Quit India Movement launched by Mahatma Gandhi in 1942.**
